notes.title: Dungeon Events Update
notes.notes:
Baker's Agony continues to grow. This update adds new unpredictable events that will make each game even more unique, more enemies and new challenges:
[list]
[*]Unique events can now occur randomly in each region of the dungeon. These events will make the areas you already know more complicated with new enemies, new and different dangers, new unique challenge bosses and better rewards.
[*]Two new Steam achievements have been created in connection with the new events.
[*]The Foundry has two new bosses that will block your path while the Primordial Furnace is being repaired.
[*]16 new swords have been added. Some of them already unlocked.
[*]A new special store has arrived in the dungeon: the Incredible Emporium of the Great Luxurious Fragrances. Buy their magical perfumes to affect the dungeon regions in different ways.
[*]Some old enemies and bosses have learned new tricks.
[*]Other small things have been adjusted and some detected bugs have been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]The shop's donation box no longer appears after the last upgrade.
[*]The parry special movement works correctly on all swords.
[*]Added autox2 and autox3 mode for sword movement.
[*]Sword movement mode is saved between runs.
[*]Help messages now appear on the NPC's interactions of the initial zone.
[*]A help tab has been added in the bestiary.
[/list]
